title: Cost Model & Router Matrix
rules: Micro-decisions (classify, route, gate, score) go to the Jev/system-1 layer: ~$0.042 / 1M input tokens, $0 output.
Local OpenJev/vLLM inference is $0: prefer it for batch labeling and nightly jobs.
Reserve frontier LLMs for open-ended synthesis, planning and code generation.
Batch independent questions in one fan-out request; latency and cost do not grow per extra question.
Cache deterministic decisions; identical state + identical question must not be re-billed.
Escalate to System 2 only when gatekeeper confidence is below the tuned threshold.
redFlags: per-token model used for yes/no routing
unbounded agent loops without decision caching
checklist: Is there a per-feature cost budget?
Are system-1 routes logged with confidence and outcome for calibration?
Is the batch path used for >3 independent evaluations?
Is there a hard monthly ceiling with graceful degradation to local models?
Are prompt payloads pruned with Winnow instead of summarized?

scoringRubric.1-3: Uncontrolled: everything hits the frontier model, costs untracked.
scoringRubric.4-6: Partial: some caching, unclear routing policy, no budgets.
scoringRubric.7-8: Routed: confidence-gated escalation, fan-out batching, per-feature budgets.
scoringRubric.9-10: Optimal: calibrated thresholds, $0 local default path, nightly auto-tuning from outcomes.
